SourceFile
  RootPackage
  public struct HeapEmpty
  public class HeapCell(var empty: HeapEmpty)
  public fun heapEmptySource(): HeapEmpty
    =
      Call HeapEmpty
  public fun heapCellSource(): HeapCell
    =
      Call HeapCell
        Call heapEmptySource
  public fun heapFieldRoundtrip(): HeapEmpty
    val cell
      Call heapCellSource
    assign .empty
      Var cell
      Call heapEmptySource
    return
      FieldAccess empty
        Var cell
